content.short: FluidTokens is a DeFi lending platform on Cardano that allows users to use their NFTs as collateral for instant loans.
content.description: FluidTokens is a premier DeFi protocol on Cardano, specializing in NFT-collateralized lending. The platform enables borrowers to unlock liquidity from their digital assets without selling them, while lenders can earn interest by providing capital backed by valuable NFTs. As the first NFT-DeFi bridge in the ecosystem, FluidTokens facilitates secure, peer-to-peer agreements governed by smart contracts. Users can borrow ADA or other native tokens against their collectibles, creating a marketplace that enhances the utility and financial flexibility of NFTs across the blockchain.
